why: Small production workshops need bill of materials, work orders and output tracking with scrap. Distinct from retail: bill of materials, output tracking and scrap tracking.
operator: The workshop owner manages bills of materials, work orders and output. Their day is job orders, material consumption and output verification against spec.
entities: Workshop (id, nameAr, nameEn, branchId, address, phone, currency, taxRegistration, openingHours)
BillOfMaterials (id, workshopId, productName, productSku, lines with componentName and quantity, totalComponents, status)
WorkOrder (id, workshopId, billOfMaterialsId, customerName, customerPhone, quantityOrdered, quantityCompleted, status (pending/in-progress/completed), scrappedQty, notes, dueDate)
Component (id, billOfMaterialsId, name, quantityPerUnit, consumedQty, remainingQty, status)
OutputRecord (id, workOrderId, actualOutputQty, expectedOutputQty, scrapQty, notes, recordedAt)
Supplier (id, workshopId, name, phone, paymentTerms, visitDays, leadTimeDays)
PurchaseOrder (id, supplierId, status, lines, expectedAt, totalPiasters)
Staff (id, workshopId, name, phone, role, hourlyRatePiasters, status)
batches: No : workshop carries no stock or expiry
expiry: Not applicable. Work orders have due dates, components are consumed per build
special: The core structures are the bill of materials per product, the work order with consumed components and the output record with scrap tracking. Bill of materials is the key differentiator from retail.
screens: Bill of materials editor: enter product name/SKU, add component lines (name, quantity per unit), save BOM, set status (active/inactive)
Work order creation: select BOM, enter customer name and phone, enter quantity ordered, set status (pending/in-progress/completed), set due date, compute total components needed
Component consumption tracker: per work order, view components, mark consumed, update remaining qty per component
Output record: enter actual output qty, compare to expected, enter scrap qty, add notes, save
Work order list: all orders with status, customer, quantity ordered, completed, scrapped, due date
Component consumption report: per BOM, which components are low or consumed per period
Output summary: actual vs expected per period, scrap total per period
Cash register: scan work order reference, record payment, print receipt
roles: Owner: everything : BOMs, work orders, output, reports, billing
Master craftsman: create BOMs, update work orders, mark output received
Workshop assistant: consume components per work order, record output
Sales rep: create work orders, client quotes, order management
reports: Work order pipeline: pending/in-progress/completed per period, average duration, scrapped qty per period
BOM component consumption: per BOM which components are low or consumed per period, reorder suggestions
Output summary: actual vs expected per period, scrap total per period and reason
Revenue per product per period: total completed work orders, revenue per product type per month
Supplier performance: lead time actual vs expected per supplier per period
integrations: Esc/POS thermal printer for receipts and output records
WhatsApp deep link for client order status updates and delivery notifications
Email for order updates and completion notices (opt-in)
onboarding: Workshop basics: name, branch, address, phone, currency, working hours
Initial bill of materials: the starting BOM for the workshop's main product with component lines
Work order types: the work order categories the workshop handles
Staff: add the initial team with their role templates
First week plan: create first BOM, first work order, first output record
seed: No sector-specific seed data. The engine provides the bill of materials and role templates.

tasks.title: Add bill of materials editor
tasks.brief: Build the BOM screen: product name/SKU, component lines (name, quantity per unit), save BOM, set status. Done when the BOM is saved and can be selected for work order creation.
tasks.done: When BOM editor works and BOM can be selected for work order

tasks.title: Add work order creation and component consumption
tasks.brief: Build the work order screen: select BOM, enter customer and phone, quantity ordered, set status, due date, compute components needed. Done when the work order saves and component consumption tracker updates correctly.
tasks.done: When work order creation works end-to-end with component consumption

tasks.title: Add component consumption tracker
tasks.brief: Build the component tracker: per work order, view components, mark consumed, update remaining qty. Done when marking a component as consumed updates the remaining qty correctly.
tasks.done: When component consumption tracker works end-to-end with remaining qty update

tasks.title: Add output record screen
tasks.brief: Build the output screen: enter actual output qty, compare to expected, enter scrap qty, add notes, save. Done when the output record saves and the work order status updates correctly.
tasks.done: When output record works end-to-end with work order status update

tasks.title: Add work order list with status and due date

tasks.done: When work order list works and filters by status correctly

tasks.done: When BOM component consumption report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add output summary report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing actual vs expected per period, scrap total per period and reason. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When output summary report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add revenue per product report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing total completed work orders and revenue per product type per month. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When revenue per product report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add supplier performance report

tasks.done: When supplier performance report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add onboarding flow for initial workshop setup

tasks.done: When onboarding flow works end-to-end and workshop is created

risks: Encryption key loss makes BOM and work order records unrecoverable
WhatsApp template rejection if not approved by Meta
Component consumption without tracking can lead to material shortages mid-production
Scrap tracking without reason can violate consumer protection law on waste reporting
